text_en: Therefore, since it is by God’s mercy that we are engaged in this ministry, we do not lose heart.
text_cn: 为此，我们既蒙垂青，获得了这职务，我们决不胆怯；

text_en: We have renounced the shameful things that one hides; we refuse to practice cunning or to falsify God’s word; but by the open statement of the truth we commend ourselves to the conscience of everyone in the sight of God.
text_cn: 反而戒绝了一切可耻的隐瞒行为，不以狡猾行事，也不变通天主的道理，只是藉着显示真理，在天主前将我们自己举荐于众人的良心。

text_en: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.
text_cn: 但如果说我们的福音也被蒙住了，那只是为丧亡的人蒙着，

text_en: In their case the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelievers, to keep them from seeing the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.
text_cn: 因为今世的神已蒙蔽了这些不信者的心意，免得他们看见基督──天主的肖像──光荣福音的光明。

text_en: For we do not proclaim ourselves; we proclaim Jesus Christ as Lord and ourselves as your slaves for Jesus’ sake.
text_cn: 因为我们不是宣传我们自己，而是宣传耶稣基督为主，我们只是因耶稣的缘故作了你们的奴仆。

text_en: For it is the God who said, “Let light shine out of darkness, ” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 因为那吩咐“光从黑暗中照耀”的天主，曾经照耀在我们心中，为使我们以那在【耶稣】基督的面貌上，所闪耀的天主的光荣的知识，来光照别人。

text_en: But we have this treasure in clay jars, so that it may be made clear that this extraordinary power belongs to God and does not come from us.
text_cn: 但我们是在瓦器中存有这宝贝，为彰显那卓著的力量是属于天主，并非出于我们。

text_en: We are afflicted in every way, but not crushed; perplexed, but not driven to despair;
text_cn: 我们在各方面受了磨难，却没有被困住；绝了路，却没有绝望；

text_en: persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed;
text_cn: 被迫害，却没有被弃舍；被打倒，却没有丧亡；

text_en: always carrying in the body the death of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be made visible in our bodies.
text_cn: 身上时常带着耶稣的死状，为使耶稣的生活也彰显在我们身上。

text_en: For while we live, we are always being given up to death for Jesus’ sake, so that the life of Jesus may be made visible in our mortal flesh.
text_cn: 的确，我们这些活着的人，时常为耶稣的缘故被交于死亡，为使耶稣的生活也彰显在我们有死的肉身上。

text_en: So death is at work in us, but life in you.
text_cn: 这样看来，死亡施展在我们身上，生活却施展在你们身上。

text_en: But just as we have the same spirit of faith that is in accordance with scripture—“I believed, and so I spoke”—we also believe, and so we speak,
text_cn: 但我们既然具有经上所载的：“我信了，所以我说”那同样的信心，我们也信，所以也说，

text_en: because we know that the one who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also with Jesus, and will bring us with you into his presence.
text_cn: 因为我们知道那使主耶稣复活的，也要使我们与耶稣一起复活，并使我们与你们一同站在他前。

text_en: Yes, everything is for your sake, so that grace, as it extends to more and more people, may increase thanksgiving, to the glory of God.
text_cn: 其实，这一切都是为了你们，为使获得恩宠的人越增多，感谢也越增加，好归光荣于天主。

text_en: So we do not lose heart. Even though our outer nature is wasting away, our inner nature is being renewed day by day.
text_cn: 为此，我们决不胆怯，纵使我们外在的人日渐损坏，但我们内在的人却日日更新，

text_en: For this slight momentary affliction is preparing us for an eternal weight of glory beyond all measure,
text_cn: 因为我们这现时轻微的苦难，正分外无比地给我们造就永远的光荣厚报，

text_en: because we look not at what can be seen but at what cannot be seen; for what can be seen is temporary, but what cannot be seen is eternal.
text_cn: 因为我们并不注目那看得见的，而只注目那看不见的；那看得见的，原是暂时的；那看不见的，才是永远的。
